No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. ## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `203a8192f6219b165134efabaaae05730c803ab9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-view-label-not-invented.test.ts, scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json + packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/rest/src/index.ts, packages/rest/package.json, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts, packages/cli/test/serve-view-container-read.integration.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/view-container-cross-package-default.dogfood.test.ts, scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, content/docs/ui/forms.mdx, and at objectui `f8267df9` (the `.objectui-sha` pin, read with `git show` from the sibling checkout) packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx and packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx

Net diff read against merge base `d132140eb`: 4 files, +417 / -11. The `.changeset/23967-view-label-not-invented.md` file is the prose face and is judged in ②. Card #23967 read whole: body, triage grade `6219439245`, claim `6220711918`, report `6222353857`. PR #24013 read whole: body, 4-file list, timeline (labels `size/m`, `documentation`, `tests`, `tooling`; one bot comment `6222326415`, the docs-drift check), and the cross-lane declaration `6222378944` on #6017.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. Which served documents change — RIGHT.** Type `view` only, two reads, both hosts.
- Item read `GET /meta/view/NAME`: `translateMetaDocument` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:2866-2897`). `translateMetaEnvelope` (`:3106-3122`) wraps it. `RestServer.translateMetaEnvelope` delegates there (`rest-server.ts:4075`), `RestServer.translateMetaItem` calls `translateMetaDocument` directly (`rest-server.ts:4041`), and the dispatcher's `answerMetaItem` calls `translateMetaEnvelope` (`runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:661-662`).
- List read `GET /meta/view`: `translateMetaList` (`:2804-2835`). `RestServer.translateMetaItems` delegates there (`rest-server.ts:4318`); the dispatcher's list chain hands it in as `translateList` (`meta.ts:582`).
- `rest-server.ts`, `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` and `packages/spec` are not in the diff, as the claim's hold-offs require.

**2. When `label` is now absent, and when it is still served — RIGHT.** The helper `withoutInventedViewLabel` (`:3069-3077`) drops the key only when all three hold: a locale resolved (`:2818`, `:2876` return the stored document untouched when none does), the stored view carried no `label` (`input.label == null`), and the translator's answer equals `input.name`. Then the served copy has no `label` key when the stored row had none; a stored `label: null` (not a schema-valid shape: `view.zod.ts:5154` is `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`, not nullable) would be served back as `null`. Still served: an authored label, including one equal to the name (`input.label != null` returns `translated` as is, `:3073`; pinned by the four `SELF` rows); a catalog translation that differs from the name (`translated.label !== input.name` returns `translated` as is; pinned by the `TAGGED` and `NAMED` `zh-CN` rows); with no catalog but a default locale, no key (pinned twice, §1 and §2); with no locale, the stored document itself (pinned, `toBe(view)`). One edge is narrowed on purpose: a catalog string equal to the view's qualified name is dropped with the fallback. The PR body says so; the container path has done the same since #22614. Acceptable.

**3. The container path keeps its answer byte-for-byte — RIGHT.** Base `projectViewTranslation` (`d132140eb` `:3010-3036`) skipped `label` inside its loop under `input.label == null && value === input.name`. Head runs the helper before the loop under the same predicate. When the helper deletes the key, the loop never sees it. When `input` carried `label: null`, the helper writes `served.label = input.label` and the loop's `value === input[key]` skips it. When nothing is dropped the helper returns `translated` itself. `out` identity is decided only by `set`, which is reached by the same keys as before, so the SAME-container rule holds. The extra copy the helper allocates when it drops is not on the wire. §3 (2 rows) and the reverse run in the report (15 red, all §3 green) agree.

**4. No other path serves the invented label — RIGHT.** Non-test callers of `translateView` at the head: `meta-item-read-gate.ts:2951` (container, through the helper), `translateMetadataDocument`'s `view` arm (reached from `:2828` and `:2892`, both through the helper), and `rest-server.ts:9311` (public form route). That route takes only `view?.config` (`:9315`) and serves its top-level label as `match.view?.label ?? match.form?.label` (`:9362`); `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx:195` already documents `null` when neither is set. `resolveViewLabel` (`i18n-resolver.ts:476-485`, the `?? view.name` at `:481`) has no caller outside `translateView`. `/layers` and `?layers=` are not translated on either host (`rest-server.ts:4155-4160` "Not translated and not cached"; `meta.ts:796`), so they never carried the fallback. `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:388-436` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:9184` name the functions in comments only.

**5. No legitimate consumer reads a served view's `label` as always present — RIGHT.**
- Spec: `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.item` is `z.unknown()` (`protocol.zod.ts:553`); `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema.items` is `z.array(z.unknown())` (`:325`); `viewItemBaseShape().label` is optional (`view.zod.ts:5154`).
- `packages/client/src`: no read of a view's `label` (grep, non-test).
- CLI `serve-view-container-read.integration.test.ts` asserts authored labels (`:284-298`, `:319`) and `not.toHaveProperty('label')` on the container (`:287`).
- Dogfood `view-container-cross-package-default.dogfood.test.ts` types `label?: unknown` (`:50`), asserts authored labels (`:91`, `:126`, `:128`, `:221`) and item-vs-list equality (`:103-104`, `:212-216`). One helper on both reads keeps that equality.
- No test under `packages/**`, `examples/**` or `packages/qa` asserts a served view's `label` equals its `name` (grep).
- Console at the pin `f8267df9`: `viewTabLabel` (`ObjectView.tsx:950-958`) types `label?: string` and draws `view.label || view.name || view.id`; `applyViewItem` (`MetadataProvider.tsx:435`) is `view.label ?? body.label`; saved views (`ObjectView.tsx:1079`) `sv.label || sv.name || id`. None requires the key. One reader improves: `viewOriginLabel` (`:962-975`) is `view.label ?? ''` for a served view, and the empty string makes the record page's back-link fall back to the object's plural label (objectui#11733), so that link stops naming the machine name.

**6. `@objectstack/rest` publication — RIGHT, no new export.** `withoutInventedViewLabel` is a module-private `function` (`:3069`); `index.ts:155-170` re-exports `translateMetaEnvelope` and `translateMetaList` only, as before. `package.json` `exports` unchanged. The published `.d.ts` changes by one JSDoc paragraph on the exported `translateMetaList` (`:2797-2800`); no signature moves.

**7. The pinned ledger row — RIGHT, gate-prescribed, not a loosening.** One row added: `packages/rest/src/meta-view-label-not-invented.test.ts`, `findOne`, pinned 1. The test's one `findOne` double calls `assertEngineFindOnePredicate` (test `:155-156`), which is what "pinned" means; its `find` double is not a scanned verb (the ledger holds `delete` 268, `findOne` 354, `update` 305 rows at the head; none for `find`). The row sits where `--write` sorts it, by file then verb (`check-engine-double-contract.mjs:2627`), between `meta-published-overlay.test.ts` and `public-form-routes.stored-row.test.ts`. 927 rows before, 928 after; none removed or moved. `record-recognisers --paths` over the four paths reads no governed path off them and defers to the changeset's `Clause-②` line, and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green on this head. The cross-lane declaration `6222378944` on #6017 says the same.

**8. The pin file — RIGHT.** 39 rows as reported: §1 8 cells (2 locales x 4 views) x 2 reads + 2 = 18, over a real `SchemaRegistry` and `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` through the registered routes; §2 16 + 3 = 19 through the two functions the dispatcher imports; §3 2 control rows. The list site guards `item && typeof item === 'object'` (`:2832`); the item site relies on `:2871`'s early return for a non-object. Both sound.

### ② Semver level

- One changeset, `'@objectstack/rest': minor`. The diff publishes exactly one package: the read gate is in `@objectstack/rest`; the test file and the ledger row publish nothing. Right package, one bump.
- BREAKING shipped as `minor`: the launch-window convention (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs:58-60`) and AGENTS.md step 3 (`(narrowing)` is BREAKING). `Check Changeset` is green on this head.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on the PR body and in the changeset. It matches the diff: nothing is newly accepted, no key is added, one served value is removed. `record-recognisers --paths` on the four paths returns no face by path and says this line decides, so the narrowing face and `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` are the right tier.
- adr-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: the gate refuses this arm only when the changeset body itself carries a migration prescription (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:147-154`). The body carries none: no FROM to TO, no retired key, no export removed. The marker's reasons are facts of the diff (no spec key or stored shape moves; no exported declaration removed or narrowed; the package publishes; no ADR-0087 id is named). `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` is green.
- Sentence by sentence against the diff: "label optional, no default" (`view.zod.ts:5154`) matches; "translator answered the view's own name" (`i18n-resolver.ts:481`) matches; "on the standalone server and on the runtime dispatcher alike" (① 1) matches; "the console drew that machine name" (`ObjectView.tsx:956`) matches; "the view-container read already dropped this value" (base `:3023`) matches; "no `label` key, in every locale, with or without a translation catalog" (① 2) matches; "an authored label is served, including one equal to the name" matches; "a catalog translation is still served, for a view with a label and for one without" matches; "a read that resolves no locale is served the stored document as before" (`:2818`, `:2876`) matches; "the layered read never carried the invented value" (① 4) matches; "Who reads differently" matches ① 5.
- Two non-blocking wording notes, no action owed: (a) "served that label, unchanged" reads as the no-catalog case; the next bullet already says a catalog translation is served for a view with a label. (b) The changeset does not state the edge the PR body states, that a catalog string equal to the qualified name is dropped with the fallback. Neither sentence misleads a consumer about when the key is absent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Surface note (fourth file, the ledger row):** answered in ① 7. Accepted.
- **Acceptance note, other translatable types (PM assumption 5):** `i18n-resolver.ts` has one `?? X.name` label fallback, `:481`, the view's. `resolveActionLabel` (`:631-640`) falls back after the catalog lookup and `translateAction` writes its answer (`:1258`), but `ActionSchema.label` is required (`action.zod.ts:959`), so no schema-valid stored action reaches it. Nothing to file. Accepted.
- **Acceptance note, the fallback's source (PM assumption 6):** `resolveViewLabel` is unchanged; after this PR no served door carries its fallback (① 4). Whether the exported resolver should stop inventing at the source is `domain:spec` ground. Escalated to the seat as optional: a `domain:spec` card, not owed by this contract.
- **Acceptance note, consumers (PM assumption 4):** confirmed in ① 5, with the one improvement at `viewOriginLabel`.
- **`sharingModel` 422 on the card's object PUT:** the card's recipe predates that authoring rule. Not this PR's; no action.
- **`os dev --artifact` from a bare directory logging a bare `@objectstack/spec` import:** outside this PR, reach unestablished, does not touch `/meta`. Escalated to the seat to decide whether to file; not blocking.
- **Report deviations:** the merge of `origin/main` (`6ff4da0d8`) brings no change of its own into the net diff; commit trailers follow AGENTS.md's model-free pair; the live boot used app-todo instead of showcase; `label-write` zero. All fine. The scratchpad disk finding is the PM's container hygiene, not a repo matter.
- **The objectui half (`viewTabLabel`'s fallback):** the seat's to file at landing. Until then the console is the SAME, not worse: `view.label || view.name` yields `recheck_gate.default` whether the server invents the label or not. The record page's back-link improves (① 5). `Console Pin Gate` was skipped on this head and the card says the pin does not build on main (#23885 / #23908), so the console was read statically at the pin, not run: NOT MEASURED at runtime.
- **Docs:** the docs-drift check (`6222326415`) found no page naming a derived anchor. No page promises the invented label; `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx:195` already documents the public form's `null`. No doc change owed.
- **Check-runs on `203a8192f6`, read at 2026-10-16T18:50Z, 39 runs:** 28 success, among them `Build Core`, `Test Core (1/6)`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` family, `Lint · ESLint`, `Check PR Size`, and the four claim checks. 6 skipped: `Console Pin Gate`, `Build Docs`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` matrix shard, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`. 5 in progress at read: `Test Core (2/6)`, `Test Core (3/6)`, `Test Core (4/6)`, `Test Core (5/6)`, `Test Core (6/6)`. The seat re-reads every check before landing.
